fields.description: An indicator which when the value is "true" means that requester expects to get qualifcation result immediately in the response. If the indicator is true then the response code of 200 indicates the operation is successful otherwise a task is created with a response 201.

fields.description: When the value is TRUE means that alternative solutions should be provided

fields.description: When the value is TRUE means that unavailability reason are expected for non available units of work.

fields.name: qualificationResult
fields.description: Qualification result for this workQualification. It could be:  qualified (all qualification item are qualified), alternate (At least one item alternate and no item with  unqualified), unqualified (At least one item unqualified)
